name: Agostino Falcone
note: Recorded in the family tree under the surname FALCONE, not Falco. No document has been found for him, and Falcone is all but absent from the Arienzo registers — two glancing index mentions against hundreds for Falco. Treated here as unproven.

name: Pasquale (Pascuale) Falco
note: Documented as a married couple of the Collegiate parish of Sant'Andrea, Arienzo, by the baptisms of at least five children between 1794 and 1802 — the entries name them together as coniugi huius parochiae. Named as father in the 1875 death record of his son Vincenzo.

name: Vincenzo Falco
note: His death record of 15 May 1875 names his father as Pasquale — the weld that joins generation 3 to generation 2.

name: Raffaele Falco
note: His death record names his father as Vincenzo. His wife Angela Rosa Morgillo, daughter of Orazio, died six days before him, on 15 April 1880.

name: Carmine Antonio Falco
note: Birth record of 10 July 1850 names his father as Raffaele. Five further children recorded at Arienzo, 1873–1883.

name: Raffaele Falco
note: A farmer of Arienzo. His last recorded child, Gerardo, was born in 1913 not at Arienzo but at Arpaia, over the provincial border — the first sign of the move north.

name: Carmine Antonio (Carminantonio) Falco
note: Born at Arienzo, resident in the province of Benevento, died in Brisbane and buried at Nudgee Cemetery with his wife. The generation that crossed the world.

name: Carmine Falco
note: Born at Forchia in the Valle Caudina. His wife Francesca Zampiello died at Brisbane in 2022.

name: Giuseppina Falco
note: Born at Benevento; her twin daughters were born at Brisbane in 1988.
